title: A Telegram channel that posts its own news digest
lead: Reads news feeds, merges duplicates, scores importance and prepares short posts with a picture for your approval.
problem: Finding the main stories among hundreds of feeds and posting on time, without manual routine.
built: News feeds and trend signals, polled every 2 minutes.
Merging of stories about one event; an importance score up to 100; a top of the day capped at seven.
Pre-publish checks: up to 1,024 characters, no links, no stop-words.
A 1080x1350 card, or a licensed Wikimedia Commons photo.
At most three posts an hour; only approved posts go out.
steps: Feeds are polled every two minutes.
Stories about one event are merged and scored.
A short post with a picture is prepared and checked.
After your approval it is published to the channel.
offer: Setup for your sources and channel.
Post checks and an approval step.
not_included: 24/7 operation without a server; any promise of reach or subscribers; photos taken from feeds; source links in posts.
